selection_scope: Freeze the complete 3x3 matrix before execution. Preflight every case before training any case. Report all admissions, rejections, and quality misses; do not simplify or retry rejected cases. No cap changes or speedup/memory comparison.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with two narrow ranges, two selected flops, complete ordered future outcomes, and forced checkdown after flop betting. No all-streets, full-deck/broad-range, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or universal accuracy claim.
